description: Single-file collaborative-style whiteboard: pen/marker/eraser with pressure-like width, shapes (line/rect/ellipse/arrow) with live preview, text tool, layers with visibility/opacity, undo/redo stack, color picker, PNG export, pan/zoom.

criteria: whiteboard_model_01.html is one self-contained drawing whiteboard (no libraries): freehand pen and marker with smooth strokes (quadratic smoothing, not raw 1px lines), eraser, shape tools for line, rectangle, ellipse and arrow with live preview while dragging, a text tool placed by click, at least 3 layers with reorder, visibility toggle and opacity, an undo/redo stack that survives at least 50 operations, a color palette with recent colors, adjustable brush width, pan and zoom of the board, clear layer, and PNG export of the composed board. Strokes must be vector-like objects, not a single flattened canvas you cannot undo.
